title: Work folder status
description: Printed by `harness status <work_dir>` (nothing is written): where a work folder stands, recomputed from question-registry.json, answers.json, inventory.json and the producers' output documents, never from the possibly stale question documents. PER PRODUCER (intake, read-structure = registry producer 'structure', callouts, marks (harness marks: member marks and schedules; like callouts its blocking questions block lot specs, not gate 1), grid-system, reader = the drawing-reader agent's questions from harness ask): `questions` counts the registry entries that are not obsolete (`total`), those that block (`blocking`, an entry without a recorded blocking flag counts as blocking and in `blocking_unknown`: rerun its producer), `blocking_open` (blocking and no active answer) and `answered` (for intake, read-structure, grid-system and reader only an active answer recorded with answered_by_role engineer counts; a simulated or role-less answer leaves the question open); `stale_answers` lists the answers whose file changed or whose question is no longer raised; `outputs` says whether the producer's documents are fresh: read-structure, callouts, marks and grid-system record the sha256 of the inventory.json they were built from (grid-system also the fingerprint of the answers it read) and are `stale` when it differs from the current one, `missing` when a document does not exist; `rerun` is the command that fixes it. GATE 1 READINESS (`gate1.ready_for_gate1`) is true only when `reasons` is empty: every probed DXF/DWG has an active answer, with a structured unit, on ITS OWN units_confirm_all question (an answer to another units code does not close it), its active unit answers agree, and the answered unit passes the units_suspect magnitude test on the inventory's dimension_median (else the reason quotes the evidence until the engineer answers units_confirm_all again or confirms the unit on the units_answer_contradicts_evidence question that harness grid-system raises; an inventory without dimension_median asks for an intake rerun); grid systems exist, grid_system_select is answered and every system the project uses (the answer's `systems` value, else every system in grid-systems.json) is axis-assigned in grid-systems.json (by grid_family_axis_assignment or grid_system_axis_unassigned answers with values; words assign nothing); no conflict (grid-systems.json `conflicts`) between two used systems that the select answer's `separate` value does not declare different buildings (an answer to a grid_system_conflict question never closes it, and is counted as open); every raised, non-obsolete level_storey_selection and level_finished_vs_structural question is answered (the selected files are not recorded in a free-text answer, so every file that raises them counts); no blocking question is open in intake, read-structure, grid-system or reader; every producer's outputs are fresh (reader: n/a). Every reason names the question id to answer (harness answer <id> ... with the values it needs). Ready does not mean the Tekla grid is built: tekla_grid is null until units and X/Y are answered, and the engineer still confirms at gate 1. Not detected: a read-structure rerun that wiped structure/grid-systems/*.svg, and changed input files that intake has not re-read (status does not see the input folder).

inventory_sha256.description: sha256 of the current inventory.json bytes.

producers.description: intake, read-structure, callouts, marks, grid-system, reader, in this order.

reasons.description: What still stops gate 1; empty exactly when ready_for_gate1 is true.

closed.description: Live questions closed without an answer of their own (lifecycle.closures); they are left out of every blocking count. Tool wave 3 (W5): always written, [] when nothing is closed; a status output from before tool wave 3 that lacks it no longer validates (rerun harness status, which writes nothing).

question_id.description: The question whose answer closes it, when one does.

non_engineer_answers.description: Active answers to gate-relevant questions that the engineer did not give (answered_by_role simulated, or no role when legacy answers do not count as the engineer's); each is also a gate-1 reason. Present only when not empty.

role.description: null: an answer recorded without a role.

total.description: Registry entries of the producer that are not obsolete.

blocking.description: Of those, the blocking ones (including blocking_unknown).

blocking_unknown.description: Entries written before the registry recorded the blocking flag: counted as blocking; rerun the producer.

blocking_open.description: Blocking entries without an active answer (intake, read-structure, grid-system, reader: without an active engineer answer).

answered.description: Entries with an active answer, blocking or not (intake, read-structure, grid-system, reader: an active engineer answer).

obsolete.description: Entries the producer no longer raises (not counted in total).

blocking_open_ids.description: The ids behind blocking_open, at most 50.

status.description: n/a: the reader produces no document from the inputs (its questions are raised one at a time by harness ask), so it has no freshness.

files.description: The documents checked, relative to the work folder.

reason.description: Why not fresh; null when fresh.

rerun.description: The command line that fixes it; null when fresh.
